readiness.hed: A sunny, mild stretch holds over Fredericksburg through Wednesday, with highs climbing from near 60 today to near 68 by midweek and clear, cool nights in between
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today turns sunny with a high near 60 before temperatures ease back to around 54 in the afternoon, then clear skies hold overnight with a low near 32. Tuesday and Wednesday both stay sunny and warm up further, with highs near 64 and 68 and clear, cool nights down into the low 30s — a calm, dry run heading toward midweek.
actions: Light winds and clear skies tonight into Tuesday morning mean frost is likely on car windshields and any exposed plants — a scraper and a cover for sensitive greenery are worth keeping handy.
Overnight lows in the low 30s through Wednesday night mean outdoor spigots and hoses are worth draining or covering before bed each night this week.
A dry, sunny run through Wednesday is a good window for outdoor church activities, yard work or travel before any new system moves in.
Morning temperatures near freezing all week mean coats and gloves at the bus stop, and a few extra minutes to defrost the car, are worth planning for.
